measured.description: False when too little of the frame has a screenshot to compare

coverage.description: Share of the frame a compared screenshot covers, 0 to 100

estimated.description: A screenshot had padding of unknown side and was placed by search

unchecked.description: Layers on show that no compared screenshot holds

placeholderIcons.description: Icons on show with no art

match.description: Match of the published frame, 0 to 100

remaining.description: What still differs and why, stand-ins and raw values

compilerFindings.description: What the compiler should have done

id.description: The id of the designer's note, as frame.load listed it

status.description: addressed: done, and detail says how. not-addressed: not done, and detail says why. not-mine: the note is about where data comes from or what it shows, which the next stage (data-bind) decides

detail.description: What was done, or why not

notes.description: One entry for each note the designer left (frame.load lists them): met, or why not. [] when it listed none
